title: Restatement § 79 — adequacy and mutuality
summary: Once consideration exists, adequacy is a separate concern from the bargain’s legal sufficiency.
notes: The notes use the provision to distinguish an actual exchange from an equal exchange and to examine nominal consideration. The full provision and its illustrations are in the Contracts Selections (PDF page 47), linked above.
